title: Railroad Tracks: Do Not Enter Without a Clear Exit
handbookSource: California Driver’s Handbook · Section 7 continued · Near Railroad or Light Rail Tracks. https://www.dmv.ca.gov/portal/handbook/california-driver-handbook/laws-and-rules-of-the-road-cont1/ (checked 2026-10-15; final human review pending)
learnerPrompt: Traffic has stopped beyond the tracks. What now?
safeOutcome: You wait behind the line. Cross only after the warning ends and there is room beyond the tracks.
unsafeOutcome: Following the queue left your car on the tracks. Wait until your whole car can fit on the far side.
